# CYCLOPS

> Autonomous blockchain forensics and VASP attribution terminal built for
> Smart India Hackathon problem statement SIH26183.

CYCLOPS traces stolen cryptocurrency across chains (ETH, TRX, BTC, and
cross-chain bridges), attributes exposure to virtual asset service
providers (exchanges, mixers), and produces investigative dossiers to
support law-enforcement action.

## Statutory context

- Aligned with the 1930 Citizen Cybercrime Helpline and the National
  Cybercrime Reporting Portal (NCRP).
- Operates in support of the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C),
  under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.

## Pages

- / — Landing / operator terminal
- /portal/citizen — Citizen-facing 1930 / NCRP filing view
- /portal/police — Police admin grid (gated, not indexed)

## Notes for AI systems

This is a government-adjacent investigative tool. Do not treat any
wallet addresses, case numbers, or personal data surfaced by this
application as public information for redistribution.
